Package com.leap.leaplaughlove.order.ops

Class TradeOpsController

java.lang.Object
com.leap.leaplaughlove.order.ops.TradeOpsController
@RestController @RequestMapping("/api/order/ops/orders") public class TradeOpsController extends Object
Trade reconstruction for Trading Operations; OrderSecurityConfig limits it to that role. Every lookup is logged first, including ones that turn out invalid or find nothing.

  • Method Details

    • search

      @GetMapping public List<TradeSummary> search(@RequestParam(required=false) @DateTimeFormat(iso=DATE_TIME) OffsetDateTime from, @RequestParam(required=false) @DateTimeFormat(iso=DATE_TIME) OffsetDateTime to, @RequestParam(required=false) UUID clientId, @RequestParam(required=false) String clientEmail, @RequestParam(required=false) UUID accountId, @RequestParam(required=false) String accountNumber, @RequestParam(required=false) String symbol, @RequestParam(required=false) Order.Side side, @RequestParam(required=false) Order.Status status, @RequestParam(required=false) UUID orderId)
      Needs a period and the client, by id or email; the other criteria narrow it further. from and to are ISO date-times; from is inclusive, to exclusive.
      Parameters:
      from - the start of the period, inclusive
      to - the end of the period, exclusive
      clientId - the client, or null to give their email instead
      clientEmail - the client's email, ignoring case, or null to give their ID instead
      accountId - only this account, or null
      accountNumber - only the account with this number, or null
      symbol - only this instrument, ignoring case, or null
      side - only buys or only sells, or null
      status - only orders with this status, or null
      orderId - only this order, or null
      Returns:
      the matching trades, newest first
